Title: Public Preview: Azure App Service - New Premium v4 Offering

Body.Content:
The new Premium v4 offering provides faster processors, NVMe local storage, and memory-optimized options, running on the latest Azure hardware. Premium v4 includes sizes starting from 1 vCPU and 4GB of memory all the way up to 32 vCPU and 256GB memory. 

Learn more: 

  • Configuring Premium v4 on Azure App Service
  • Azure App Service pricing
